name: Restaurant Order Puzzle
task:
Please complete the following four-stage logic puzzle task in order.

Five diners ordered different dishes (steak, pasta, salad, soup, burger) with different sides (fries, rice, bread, veggies, mash) at different prices ($12, $15, $18, $20, $25). Extract these facts:
- The steak costs more than the pasta
- The salad comes with bread
- The $15 dish is not the burger
- The soup is the cheapest item
- The pasta comes with veggies

Apply these additional constraints:
- The burger costs $18
- The dish with fries costs $20
- The steak does not come with rice
- The dish with mash costs more than the dish with rice
- The salad is not the most expensive

Eliminate impossible dish-side-price combinations. Cross-reference to narrow down.

Output each dish, its side, and its price. Verify all constraints.

subtasks.name: Direct fact extraction from puzzle description
